resources.string: Tick items as you prepare. Tap the text to edit it, or add and remove items.
Include what applies to you. Collect documents only when it is safe to do so.
This section is full. Shorten or remove an item before adding more text.

string-array.name: safety_document_checklist
string-array.item: Driver’s licence / government-issued photo ID
Birth certificates
Passport / citizenship / immigration documents
Health card
Prescriptions
Medical records, if needed
Social Insurance Number (SIN)
Court orders / protection orders
Marriage / parenting / custody documents, if applicable
Banking / insurance / housing records, if needed

string-array.name: safety_grab_checklist
string-array.item: House and vehicle keys
Phone and charger
Cash and bank cards
Essential medicines
Basic clothes and toiletries
Children’s or pets’ essentials, if applicable

string-array.name: safety_destination_checklist
string-array.item: Choose a safe place to go.
Write down the address and how to find it.
Check when you can arrive.

string-array.name: safety_travel_checklist
string-array.item: Decide how you will get there.
Confirm who can help with transport, if needed.
Prepare keys, fare or fuel when it is safe to do so.

resources.string: Who can you go to, and can you stay with them?

string-array.name: safety_contacts_checklist
string-array.item: Write a trusted person’s name and safe contact details.
Ask whether you can stay with them and for how long.
Agree on a safe way to check in or ask for help.

resources.string: What will you do after you leave?

string-array.name: safety_aftercare_checklist
string-array.item: Let a trusted person know you arrived, when safe.
Plan essentials for the first few days: shelter, food and medication.
Identify support services you may want to contact.
